Title: Get all employees - Success
Description: Verify that the GET /api/employe endpoint returns a list of all employees successfully.
Pre-Conditions: At least one employee exists in the database.
Test Steps: Send a GET request to /api/employe
Verify the response status code is 200 OK
Verify the response body contains a list of employee objects
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with a JSON array of employee objects, each containing valid employee fields.

Title: Get employee by valid ID - Success
Description: Verify that the GET /api/employe/{id} endpoint returns the employee details when a valid employee ID is provided.
Pre-Conditions: An employee with ID 1 exists in the database.
Test Steps: Send a GET request to /api/employe/1
Verify the response status code is 200 OK
Verify the response body contains the employee details with ID 1
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with a JSON object containing employee details for ID 1.

Title: Get employee by non-existing ID - Returns empty employee
Description: Verify that the GET /api/employe/{id} endpoint returns an empty employee object when the employee ID does not exist.
Test Steps: Send a GET request to /api/employe/9999
Verify the response status code is 200 OK
Verify the response body contains an empty employee object (default values)
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with a JSON object representing an empty employee (default constructor values).

Title: Create new employee - Success
Description: Verify that the POST /api/employee endpoint creates a new employee successfully when valid data is provided.
Pre-Conditions: No employee with the same ID exists.
Test Steps: Send a POST request to /api/employee with valid employee JSON body
Verify the response status code is 200 OK or 201 Created
Verify the employee is saved in the database
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK or 201 Created and the employee record is persisted with the provided details.

Title: Create new employee - Missing required fields
Description: Verify that the POST /api/employee endpoint handles missing required fields gracefully.
Test Steps: Send a POST request to /api/employee with an empty or incomplete employee JSON body
Verify the response status code indicates failure (e.g., 400 Bad Request) or no exception occurs
Verify no employee is created
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request or 200 OK with no employee created; server handles missing fields without crashing.

Title: Update existing employee - Success
Description: Verify that the PUT /api/employee/{id} endpoint updates an existing employee's details successfully.
Pre-Conditions: An employee with ID 1 exists in the database.
Test Steps: Send a PUT request to /api/employee/1 with updated employee JSON body
Verify the response status code is 200 OK
Verify the response body contains the updated employee details
Verify the employee record is updated in the database
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with updated employee details reflecting the changes.

Title: Update non-existing employee - Not Found
Description: Verify that the PUT /api/employee/{id} endpoint returns 404 Not Found when trying to update a non-existing employee.
Test Steps: Send a PUT request to /api/employee/9999 with employee JSON body
Verify the response status code is 404 Not Found
Verify the response body is empty
Expected Result: Response status 404 Not Found with empty response body.

Title: Delete existing employee - Success
Description: Verify that the DELETE /api/employee/{id} endpoint deletes an existing employee successfully.
Pre-Conditions: An employee with ID 1 exists in the database.
Test Steps: Send a DELETE request to /api/employee/1
Verify the response status code is 200 OK or 204 No Content
Verify the employee record is removed from the database
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK or 204 No Content and employee record is deleted.

Title: Delete non-existing employee - No error
Description: Verify that the DELETE /api/employee/{id} endpoint handles deletion of a non-existing employee gracefully.
Test Steps: Send a DELETE request to /api/employee/9999
Verify the response status code is 200 OK or 204 No Content
Verify no error is returned
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK or 204 No Content with no error, even though employee did not exist.

Title: Get all employees - Verify response structure
Description: Verify that the GET /api/employe endpoint returns employee objects with expected fields: id, name, role, absent.
Pre-Conditions: At least one employee exists in the database.
Test Steps: Send a GET request to /api/employe
Verify the response status code is 200 OK
Verify each employee object contains fields: id (number), name (string), role (string), absent (boolean)
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with JSON array of employee objects containing all expected fields with correct data types.
